root_cause_analysis.issue: Incorrect REPO_ROOT path resolution in run_mutation_selective.sh
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: REPO_ROOT computed as SCRIPT_DIR/.. (one level up from .github/scripts/) which resolves to .github/ instead of repo root. Should be SCRIPT_DIR/../..
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Changed REPO_ROOT to SCRIPT_DIR/../.. matching all other CI scripts
root_cause_analysis.also_fixed: generate_mutation_report.py used hardcoded Path('backend/tests/generated/mutation') relative to cwd; now computes absolute paths from __file__
root_cause_analysis.cascade_failure: Wrong REPO_ROOT -> cd //backend fails silently due to set -eo pipefail interaction -> mutmut runs from repo root -> FileNotFoundError: src/engines/ not found -> workflow reports infrastructure failure, not genuine mutation score
root_cause_analysis.consistency_check: All other CI scripts (run_backend_verification.sh, run_frontend_verification.sh, run_golden_tests.sh, etc.) correctly use SCRIPT_DIR/../.. for REPO_ROOT. Only run_mutation_selective.sh had the incorrect single-level traversal.
